nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What factors are mentioned as having significant negative impacts on the quality of inland-sea and coastal waters?
nodes.answer: Urbanisation, industrial activities, agricultural activities, and warfare are mentioned as factors that have significant negative impacts on the quality of inland-sea and coastal waters.

nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What role do the river systems mentioned play in the health of the North-Western Black Sea (NWBS)?
nodes.answer: The river systems provide the main riverine inputs to the NWBS and are the principal source of anthropogenic pollution into the NWBS, impacting its health.
